confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated travel-guide and cost-of-living snippets, not official statistics, and the sources disagree somewhat. Euro figures were converted to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR. Beer, coffee and cocktail anchors are the least certain of the food set, and cocktail and wine are estimated from the usual Split bar range rather than a confirmed menu. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Dalmatian coastal summer context; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were inspected. The FX observation comes from search-result snippets that attribute a 18 Nov 2026 RBA AUD/USD figure to the RBA exchange-rates page; I could not open the RBA table directly, so it should be verified against the RBA's F11.1 series.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a Eurozone Adriatic coastal city in peak summer, comparable to other Dalmatian tourist centres such as Dubrovnik and Zadar, with food prices anchored to aggregated Split guide ranges and summer uplift applied for July.
